title: ServiceAccountCreateRequest
description: Register a machine identity (POST /v1/admin/service-accounts body). This registers the ACCOUNT RECORD only — it does NOT mint, store, or rotate a credential. The API key itself lives in the server environment (API_KEYS / API_KEY_TENANTS / API_KEY_ROLES) and is an operator edit plus a restart; the request body must therefore never carry key material.

subject.description: The account's subject, which must equal the API-key tenant the operator maps the key to. Colon-free: ':' is reserved for federated 'issuer:sub' identities, so a colon here is a 400. The reserved tenants 'default' and 'public' are a 400 too — every valid but unmapped API key resolves to 'default', so a service row on it would turn a single disable into a deployment-wide lockout that no API route can undo.

purpose.description: Free text: what this credential is for (audit aid). Defaults to an empty string.
